<void Void /> Weapon Kills against <link Elites, Minibosses, and Champions [#CombatantClassifications] /> grant <void Volatile Rounds /> for 10.5 seconds while on a <void Void /> Subclass.

10 second cooldown between activations.

source.text:
While on a Void Subclass:
Upon scoring a Void Weapon Kill against an Elite, Miniboss, or Champion:

Volatile Rounds for 10.5 seconds.

Incurs a 10 second cooldown upon triggering.
